These fixtures are pinned copies. Folio does not generate them and never
edits them.

| Path | Source | Commit |
|---|---|---|
| `purchase-request/projection.json`, `purchase-request/diagram.html` | kemiller2002/forma-studio `examples/purchase-request/folio-projection/`, generated by `FormaStudio.Cli project` (projection 1.0.0) | `7579d4000c1299ea194d667fc018719b854ab98a` |
| `forma/tokens.css`, `forma/foundations.css`, `forma/components.css` | kemiller2002/forma `dist/` built with `npm run build`, diagram presentation contract 2.0.0 (forma PR #91) | `19422c3c2c097d9110811e77693c080afdbd540e` |

The Forma CSS is a test-fixture dependency only. Folio does not ship or load

projection or the Forma diagram contract changes.
